name: Intrusion 2

steps: Press Play online. A message shows your room code; send it to your friend. For three or four players use Host a room for 3 or 4 players under Other ways to connect: the game starts once everyone has joined.
Your friends type the code in Join by code, or pick your room in the Rooms list.
Start the mission once everyone is in.
tips: Up to four soldiers fight through the missions together.
Everyone needs the same Ruffle Together build and game file; the launcher keeps them current.

description: The sequel to Intrusion. Online play runs in Ruffle Together: up to four soldiers fight through the missions together.

actions.label: Play online
actions.description: Host a room for 2 players, or join one with a code
actions.hint: Send the room code the message shows to your friend. The game opens once they join. For 3 or 4 players use Other ways to connect.

actions.label: Host a room for 3 players
actions.description: The game starts when 2 friends have joined
actions.hint: Send the room code the message shows to your two friends. The game opens once both have joined.

actions.label: Host a room for 4 players
actions.description: The game starts when 3 friends have joined
actions.hint: Send the room code the message shows to your three friends. The game opens once all have joined.

actions.label: Host with your IP (2 players)
actions.hint: Friends copy your address and port (for example 192.168.1.20:7790) and press Join by IP. Radmin, Tailscale and LAN addresses work.

actions.label: Host with your IP (3 players)
actions.description: Direct connect on port 7790; starts when 2 friends have joined
actions.hint: Friends copy your address and port and press Join by IP. The game opens once both have joined.

actions.label: Host with your IP (4 players)
actions.description: Direct connect on port 7790; starts when 3 friends have joined
actions.hint: Friends copy your address and port and press Join by IP. The game opens once all have joined.

actions.label: Join by IP
actions.hint: The game opens once you are connected to the host.
